mape.definition: mean of 100*abs(p70-actual)/actual over rows with actual>0, per location/category/clock-hour
mape.zero_policy: zero-actual rows are excluded from the MAPE denominator but counted; an all-zero group is unscorable

quantiles.p70_definition: P70 hit rate is actual <= p70
quantiles.interval_definition: P10-P90 coverage is lower <= actual <= upper
